update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.42 - Fix Trackblazer shop not buying when unlock/discount dialog appears mid-run
Fixes --- - The Shop unlock/discount dialog handler dismissed the popup and went straight into buying without confirming the Shop's item list was actually on screen. If the dismissal landed back on the main screen instead, the buy pass would silently scan the wrong screen and find nothing to purchase. It now calls openShop() to verify (and re-navigate into) the Shop screen before buying, matching the other shop-entry call sites.
